title: Feedback where the student is looking
statement: Show feedback directly under the answer or option it responds to, and keep the text in view whenever feedback says to look back.
detail: The reading course's checklist requires the reply to a wrong answer to render directly under the tapped option, checked by a code tripwire, and the passage to be on screen whenever feedback says to look back, as a blocking row (`grade3-reading/artifacts/AlphaRead-QC-Checklist-v2-2026-09-04.md`, lines 72 and 103). A visual pass on one lesson found a correct reply rendered under a box on the right while the tapped line sat on the left, usually off screen (`grade3-reading/artifacts/peter-pan-standing-2026-09-11/VISUAL-QA-2026-09-11.md`, lines 43-46).
